Services¶

Services for publishing, approval logging, and subscriber emails.

news.services.log_approved_article(article, editor)[source]¶

Send an approved article to the API using the supplied account.

Create or reuse the account’s authentication token. Raise requests.RequestException if the request fails or the API returns a status other than 200 or 201.

news.services.email_article_subscribers(article)[source]¶

Submit one email with subscriber addresses hidden in BCC.

news.services.publish_article(article, editor)[source]¶

Approve an article and attempt API logging and subscriber emails.

When retrying an approved article, skip steps already marked as successful. Return a list of error messages for failed delivery steps.

news.services.email_newsletter_subscribers(newsletter)[source]¶

Email a newly created newsletter to its active subscribers.

Permissions¶

Queries that limit article and newsletter access by user role.

news.permissions.editable_articles(user)[source]¶

Return articles the user is allowed to manage.

Editors receive articles belonging to their publishers. Journalists receive their own articles. Other users receive an empty queryset.

news.permissions.editable_newsletters(user)[source]¶

Return newsletters the user is permitted to manage.

news.permissions.visible_articles(user)[source]¶

Return approved articles within the user’s browsing scope.

Authenticated editors receive articles belonging to their publishers. Other users receive all approved articles.

news.permissions.visible_newsletters(user)[source]¶

Return newsletters within the user’s browsing scope.
